status.summary: October 9 site reporting describes Phase 2 engineers performing pre-operation functional tests. Named project manager Zhang Yuanyuan states that civil structure, external walls and MEP installation are complete and the validation round remains. End-October testing/acceptance and year-end operation are forecasts. This is attributed reporting, not an official inspection.

locator.precision: Operator-selected parent-campus marker transformed from BD09 by EOIA inversion of the documented Baidu GPS-to-BD09 API. It does not identify a phase building, footprint, construction extent or surveyed campus centroid.
locator.identity_review: The existing operator directory explicitly names Boda Langfang No. 2 and binds it to its selected Baidu campus point. The October 12 report explicitly identifies Phase 2 at that same campus and separately discusses Phase 1. Reuse the prior reviewed BD09-to-WGS84 campus marker; no Phase 2 building position is asserted.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Operator provides no measured positional accuracy. Absolute transformation accuracy and offset to individual phase buildings remain unknown. Numerical API roundtrip residuals and six output decimal places are not ground accuracy bounds.

additions.distinctness_review: Reviewed all 406 base sites and 430 projects. The same campus already contains Phase 1, project 760bbd20-e137-5015-9956-1d5b17000e18. Phase 2 is a separately identified construction and testing scope. No existing Phase 2 project key or other Langfang No. 2 phase record exists.
additions.successor_review: October 12 report records the October 9 test state and future end-October acceptance/year-end production. No subsequent achieved acceptance or operating observation was established through October 14. Prior blocked Langfang-government route was not retried; the accessible Hebei CAC republication is captured separately.

additions.site_identity_review: The dated report explicitly identifies Phase 2 of Boda Langfang No. 2, alongside the same campus Phase 1. Reuse the already reviewed operator-selected parent-campus point and physical-site ID; do not add a second physical site or overwrite Phase 1.

context_updates.identity_review: Named project manager distinguishes existing Phase 1 from Phase 2 at the same Boda Langfang No. 2 campus.
context_updates.summary: The report gives Phase 1 opening only as October 2025; exact opening day remains unknown. The separately recorded Phase 2 commissioning state does not replace the existing Phase 1 operating observation.
